about.heading: What AskDocuMind does
about.body: AskDocuMind is a document-aware chatbot API. Upload a document, ask a question, and get back an answer that's grounded in your file's actual content — with sources, not guesses.

audience.description: Developers evaluating a document QA API
Students and researchers digging through long papers
Anyone tired of re-reading a PDF to find one answer

howItWorks.heading: How it works

steps.title: Upload

steps.description: Ask questions about it in natural language.
